purpose: Bounded eight-pair follow-up pilot plan; no automatic replacement candidates are authorized.

candidates.target_description: the round copper pan hanging above the center-left cooking range
candidates.placement_rationale: The target is visible before generation and the tightened mask stays around the selected hanging pan without covering the cook.
candidates.prompt: a round brass wall clock mounted naturally on the kitchen wall, matching the warm indoor lighting

instruction_review.note: The copper pan is visible. The prior rectangle included more adjacent cookware; the revised rectangle is narrower and excludes the cook.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the pan-to-clock replacement instruction.

candidates.target_description: the white range hood and honey-colored upper cabinets above the stove and counter
candidates.placement_rationale: The upper fixture group is visible before generation; the large region remains above the foreground table and fruit bowl and avoids the lower stove body.
candidates.prompt: matte navy-blue upper kitchen cabinets with a stainless-steel range hood, realistic residential interior photograph

instruction_review.note: The prior bbox cut through the stove/cabinet unit and its mask approached the fruit bowl. The revision targets only the visible upper fixture group while retaining the required large class.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the upper-cabinet/range-hood replacement.

candidates.target_description: a framed botanical print to insert on the empty upper-left wall
candidates.placement_rationale: The upper-left wall was proposed as the support surface, but the required large-class rectangle overlaps the cat and sink; no safe placement is established and generation must remain blocked pending a reviewed revision.
candidates.prompt: a framed botanical print hanging flat on the bathroom wall, realistic perspective and indoor lighting

instruction_review.note: The registered 300x300 large-class rectangle covers substantial portions of the existing cat and sink. The rationale claiming it does not replace the cat is not supported by the image.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Do not approve as written. Decide whether to revise the locked candidate/class through a reviewed plan amendment; no safe large insertion region was established on this image.

candidates.target_description: a small red cherry tomato to insert on the bread slice
candidates.placement_rationale: The bread provides a visible horizontal support surface and the small mask avoids the surrounding lunch compartments.
candidates.prompt: a small red cherry tomato resting on the slice of bread, matching the lunchbox lighting and camera angle

instruction_review.note: The target bbox lies on the bread and the small mask avoids adjacent lunch compartments.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the tomato insertion instruction.

candidates.target_description: the foreground forested rocky headland occupying the lower-right quadrant
candidates.placement_rationale: The existing landform is identified before removal; the revised region contains its visible cliff and vegetation while leaving the sky and main horizon outside the mask.
candidates.prompt: open sea and distant coastline continuing naturally through the removed foreground headland, photorealistic sunset landscape

instruction_review.note: The prior bbox mixed distant and foreground landforms and cut off the lower target. The revision identifies the foreground headland and keeps the sky outside the mask.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise removal of the full foreground headland.

candidates.target_description: a brown leather travel suitcase to insert on the cobblestones beside the car
candidates.placement_rationale: The lower-left cobblestone area is a visible ground plane beside the vehicle; the tightened region stops before the front wheel assembly.
candidates.prompt: a brown leather travel suitcase standing on the cobblestones beside the vintage car, realistic scale and daylight shadows

instruction_review.note: The prior mask clipped the front-wheel boundary despite its rationale. The revised mask remains on cobblestones and ends before the wheel.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the suitcase size and placement.

candidates.target_description: a small dark bird to insert in the open cloudy sky at upper-right
candidates.placement_rationale: The sky region is visually unobstructed and supports a small airborne object without altering the monument text or sculpture.
candidates.prompt: a small dark bird flying in the cloudy sky, distant scale and natural daylight

instruction_review.note: The registered region is open sky and does not cover the monument, inscription, or sculpture.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the small-bird insertion instruction.

candidates.target_description: the bronze child figure held across the adult figure's arms
candidates.placement_rationale: The child figure is visibly bounded before generation; the large registered region covers it and its contact with the adult's arms.
candidates.prompt: a bronze bouquet of flowers held naturally in the figure's arms, matching the sculpture material, patina, and daylight

instruction_review.note: The child figure is visible and the mask is tighter than before. Because the child contacts the adult's arms and hands, some contact-region alteration is unavoidable for this large replacement.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve only if alteration risk to the adult arms/hands is acceptable; otherwise revise the instruction.
